name: Qlarr Self-Hosted
free_limit: Self-hosted survey editor and response collection with JSON/JavaScript survey logic, offline-first workflows, branching, validation and multilingual surveys; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiration documented.
watch_out: Requires your own server, database and Docker infrastructure; hosting costs are not included. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified network deployments. README quick-start references an older frontend repository path; verify current deploy/ instructions and replace default admin credentials before production use. Hosted Qlarr Console is a separate offering.
